title: Lost Vape Galaxy T360 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Lost Vape Galaxy T360 is a compact pod kit that combines simple, draw-activated performance with a dazzling 360-degree “Galaxy” LED wraparound display. A built-in 1200mAh battery delivers up to 35W and you can choose between Single Mesh and Dual Mesh output modes to adjust warmth and vapour. A precise airflow slider supports everything from a tighter mouth-to-lung (MTL) pull to a looser restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) inhale. The panoramic LED wrap uses over 300 micro LEDs to create a seamless, full-body display around the device. It shows battery and mode status at a glance and includes quick controls via the single multi-function button: press once to wake the screen, three times to enter Power Saving, and five times to power on/off. The result is clear status lighting that’s easy to read in any orientation. The kit includes a 2ml URSA V3 top-fill pod fitted with an integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil for smooth flavour with 50/50 or nicotine salt e-liquids. The T360 also works with URSA V1 and V2 pods, giving you more resistance and draw options without changing device. USB-C charging and a supplied lanyard round out a pocket-ready design. Colours: Ocean Galaxy, Sakura Galaxy, Lava Galaxy. Shop our vape liquid uk collection to find flavours that go hand in hand with this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
